fione.name: Fione-kun
fione.message.1: This model could not beat a simple guess yet. Check that the column to predict is the right one and that the input columns relate to it, then run again.
fione.message.2: The model is a little better than guessing. More rows, more useful columns or a longer run may help.
fione.message.3: Not bad! The model is useful. More data or a longer run may make it better still.
fione.message.4: Great job! The model predicts well. Try it on new data.
fione.message.5: Excellent! The model predicts very well. Let's put it to work on new data.
task.classification.explain: Predicts a category for each row, such as a species or yes / no.
task.regression.explain: Predicts a number for each row, such as a price or a temperature.
rating.note.no_metric: The score needed for the rating is missing, so the rating is the lowest.
rating.note.single_class: The training data had only one class, so there was nothing to learn.
rating.note.constant_target: The column to predict had the same value in every row, so there was nothing to learn.
rating.how_text: Fione tests the model on rows it did not learn from (cross-validation) and compares it with a simple guess.
rating.how_classification: For categories, the simple guess always picks the most common one. The rating shows how much of the remaining room to a perfect score the model covers: (accuracy - share of the most common category) / (1 - that share).
rating.how_regression: For numbers, the simple guess is always the average. The rating is 1 - (typical error of the model / typical error of the average), where the typical error is the root mean squared error.
rating.how_bands: This gives a score from 0 to 1: below 0.2 is 1 star, then one more star at 0.2, 0.4, 0.6 and 0.8. A model whose training hit an error gets at most 2 stars.

upload.title: Upload training data
upload.lead: Fione learns from examples. Upload a CSV file with one example per row and a header row with the column names.
upload.guide: Include the column you want to predict, for example the species of a flower or the price of a house, plus the columns that may help predict it.
upload.rule_format: CSV only. Columns may be separated by commas, semicolons, tabs or |.
upload.rule_encoding: Text encodings: UTF-8, Shift_JIS or EUC-JP.
upload.rule_header: The first row must hold the column names.
upload.error.form: The upload did not arrive in one piece. Choose the file again and retry.
upload.error.missing: Choose a CSV file to upload.
upload.error.too_large: The file is larger than the upload limit. Remove some rows or columns, or ask an administrator to raise the limit.
upload.error.encoding: Fione could not read the text of this file. Save it as CSV in UTF-8 (or Shift_JIS) and try again. Excel files must be saved as CSV first.
upload.error.empty: The file is empty. Choose a CSV file that has data.
upload.error.no_rows: The file has column names but no data rows. Add rows below the header and try again.
upload.error.parse: Fione could not read the file as CSV. Check that every row has the same number of columns as the header.
upload.error.invalid: Fione could not use this file. Check that it is a CSV file and try again.
analysis.title: Data analysis
analysis.lead: Tell Fione what to predict in “{name}” and which columns to learn from.
analysis.sampled: Column details are based on the first {n} rows.
analysis.target: What do you want to predict?
analysis.target_hint: The model learns to fill in this column for new rows.
analysis.detected.classification: “{name}” holds {values} different values, so Fione suggests classification: predicting which value each row has.
analysis.detected.regression: “{name}” holds numbers with many different values, so Fione suggests regression: predicting a number for each row.
analysis.warn.not_train: This is not training data, so it cannot be used to train a model.
analysis.warn.one_column: The data has only one column. Add columns the model can learn from.
analysis.warn.target_id: The column to predict looks like an ID (every value is different). Check that this is the column you want.
analysis.warn.leaks: {n} columns might give the answer away (they match the column to predict too closely). They are unchecked below.
analysis.error.summary: Please check the following, then run again:
analysis.error.target: Choose a column to predict from the list.
analysis.error.inputs_unknown: Some selected input columns are not in this data. Reload the page and choose again.
analysis.error.inputs_empty: Choose at least one input column for the model to learn from.
analysis.error.runtime: Enter the maximum run time as a whole number of minutes, 1 or more.
analysis.error.config: Fione could not start training with these settings.
analysis.inputs: Which columns should the model learn from?
analysis.inputs_hint: Checked columns are the inputs. Fione has unchecked columns that would not help, with the reason shown.
analysis.col.name: Column
analysis.reason.id: Looks like an ID: every value is different, so it cannot help predict.
analysis.reason.constant: Has the same value in every row, so it cannot help predict.
analysis.reason.leak_identical: Is identical to the column to predict: it would give the answer away.
analysis.reason.leak_correlated: Moves almost exactly with the column to predict: it may give the answer away.
analysis.reason.leak_determines: Each of its values always comes with the same answer: it may give the answer away.
analysis.kind_note: Kind is what Fione detected each column holds.
analysis.task_hint: Fione suggests one from the column to predict. Change it only if the suggestion is wrong.
analysis.runtime_hint: Training stops when this time is up and keeps the best model found. Longer runs can find better models.
analysis.runtime_custom_label: Other maximum run time, in minutes
analysis.what_text: Fione trains several kinds of models on your {rows} rows, checks each on rows it did not learn from, and keeps the best one, or a blend of the best ones.
analysis.what_background: Training runs on the server: you can leave this page and come back later.
analysis.viewer_note: You have view-only access, so you cannot start training. Ask the project owner for edit access.
job.lead.automl: Fione is trying models and keeping the best. This page updates by itself.
job.lead.batch_predict: Fione is running your data through the model. This page updates by itself.
job.best_hint: The error is measured on rows the models did not learn from: lower is better.
job.stage.queued: Waiting to start. Training begins as soon as the server is free.
job.done.automl: Training is finished! Let's see how well the model predicts.
job.failed_title: The run failed with this message:
job.failed_hint: Change the data or the settings it mentions, then run again.
job.cancelled_text: This run was stopped before it finished, so nothing was saved. You can change the settings and run again.
job.cancel_effect.automl: Training stops and no model is saved. You can run it again later.
job.cancel_effect.batch_predict: Predicting stops and no result is saved.
job.cancel_effect.other: The run stops and its result is not saved.
job.leave_note: You can leave this page: the run continues on the server.
summary.title: Prediction summary
summary.score.accuracy: On rows it did not learn from, the model was right about {pct}% of the time. Always guessing the most common answer would be right {base}% of the time.
summary.score.auc: On rows it did not learn from, the model told the two classes apart with an AUC of {auc} (0.5 is guessing, 1 is perfect).
summary.score.rmse: On rows it did not learn from, the model's predictions were typically off by about {error}. Always guessing the average would be off by about {spread}.
summary.score.r2: On rows it did not learn from, the model explained about {pct}% of the variation in the values.
summary.degraded: Training hit an error and kept the best model it had by then. The model works, but may be weaker than usual. Running again may help.
summary.ensemble_hint: A blend averages the predictions of several models, which is often more accurate than any one of them.
summary.top_inputs_hint: The columns the model relied on most, as a share of all it used.
summary.predict_text: Upload a CSV with the same input columns and download the predictions.
summary.predict_viewer: You have view-only access, so you cannot make predictions.
summary.serving_title: Serve it from your own system
summary.serving_text: Download the serving bundle, unzip it and start it with Docker to get predictions over HTTP.
summary.serving_run: Then run this where you unzipped it:
summary.serving_unavailable: The serving bundle is not available for this model. Ask an administrator to check the serving image settings.
predict.title: New prediction
predict.lead: Upload data and “{name}” will predict {target} for every row.
predict.error.model: The model file is missing or damaged, so it cannot predict. Train the model again.
predict.error.missing: The file is missing {n} columns the model needs:
predict.error.missing_hint: Add these columns (with the same names) and upload the file again.
predict.needs_hint: Other columns are fine: they are ignored by the model, and you can keep them in the result. {target} itself is not needed.
predict.error.run: Fione could not start the prediction.
predict.ready: “{name}” ({rows} rows) has every column the model needs. Choose what to put in the result.
predict.extra: {n} columns are not used by the model. You can still keep them in the result.
predict.output_hint: The prediction is always included. Checked columns from your file are copied next to it.
predict.columns_explain: “predict” is the prediction. For categories, each “p_” column is the probability of that category.
result.title: Predictions
result.guide: Here are your predictions! Download the CSV to use them in a spreadsheet or another system.
result.columns_explain: “predict” is the prediction. For categories, each “p_” column is the probability of that category.
analysis.target_error.few_rows: Training needs at least {min} rows, and this data has {n}. Add more rows.
analysis.target_error.missing: The column to predict is empty in {n} rows. Training refuses it: fill in or remove those rows, or choose another column.
analysis.target_error.single_value: The column to predict has the same value in every row, so there is nothing to predict. Choose another column.
analysis.target_error.not_numeric: Regression predicts numbers, but the column to predict holds text. Choose classification, or another column.
analysis.target_error.infinite: The column to predict holds infinite values. Replace or remove them, then try again.
analysis.target_error.too_many_classes: The column to predict has {n} different values, too many to predict as categories. Choose regression if it holds numbers, or another column.
analysis.target_error.single_row_class: The value “{label}” of the column to predict appears in only one row ({n} such values). Each value needs at least 2 rows: add rows or remove those.
analysis.error.target_data: Training would refuse the column to predict as it is. See the red notice above the columns for what to change.
analysis.error.too_many_fields: This data has too many columns to choose from in the form. Remove columns you do not need from the file and upload it again.
job.gone_hint: This run can no longer be shown here. It may have been deleted, or your access to the project changed.
